title: Command Execution Fails Silently in Claude Chat Interface
body: **Bug Description** When I run command in Claude with !prefix, neither Claude nor I see it's output. However, when I see the same command in regular console, I see detailed output (type errors). Command in this particular case was `bun run --cwd services/service-name tsc -f`.
